title: GET /api/v1/cards/{id} 200
description: One card and the provenance of the index that answered. The body carries no request_id (the X-Request-Id header does), so equal answers carry equal weak ETags. A miss is a 404 and a malformed id a 400, both error.json.

seed.description: Which pokemon-tcg-data commit the index was seeded from, and when. Both members are always present; both are null for an index seeded before provenance stamping.
